rules.DryWatch: 3-month rain at or below 75% of normal and soil moisture in the driest 25% for this month
rules.FloodWatch: rain at or above 150% of normal this month on soil already in the wettest 25%
rules.SlopeWatch: a hill district where soil is in the wettest 25% and rain is at or above 130% of normal
rules.ground_wetness: GLDAS root-zone soil moisture when it is no more than a month old; GLDAS runs about 3 months behind, so for recent months the rank of the last 3 months of rain against the same months in 2001-2025 stands in for it
